name: prose
purpose: A short plain-text answer or message (1–4 sentences). Always lead a reply with one.

name: card
purpose: A card linking to one of the numbered results — set its ref to the result number. One card per result worth showing, most relevant first.

name: chat-replies
purpose: Two or three short tap-to-answer options that NARROW the conversation. Use when the topic is broad, or your answer could go several ways, so the visitor can pick a direction instead of having to phrase one — and to stop a wide question getting wider. Skip them when the next step is already obvious.

name: form
purpose: A lead/quote/contact form the visitor fills in — offer it for a quote, to be contacted, or another lead-gen action the guides can't answer (only a form that exists in the site).

name: figure
purpose: An image shown from a retrieved result (by its number); use only when a visual genuinely helps.
